page.overview:
What is The Way of Kings?

The Way of Kings is an epic fantasy novel written by American author Brandon Sanderson and the firstthumb book in The Stormlight Archive series. The novel was published on August 31, 2010 by Tor Books.

The Way of Kings consists of one prelude, one prologue, 75 chapters, an epilogue and 9 interludes. It was followed by Words of Radiance in 2014. In 2011, it won the David Gemmell Legend Award for best novel.

The unabridged audiobook is read by narrator team Michael Kramer and Kate Reading. I long for the days before the Last Desolation. com/wiki/Herald Heralds] abandoned us and the Knights Radiant turned against us.

A time when there was still magic in the world and honor in the hearts of men. The world became ours, and we lost it. Nothing, it appears, is more challenging to the souls of men than victory itself.

The novel was published on August 31, 2010 by Tor Books. The Way of Kings consists of one prelude, one prologue, 75 chapters, an epilogue and 9 interludes. It was followed by Words of Radiance in 2014. In 2011, it won the David Gemmell Legend Award for best novel. The unabridged audiobook is read by narrator team Michael Kramer and Kate Reading. I long for the days before the Last Desolation. The age before the [https://stormlightarchive.fandom.com/wiki/Herald Heralds] abandoned us and the Knights Radiant turned against us. A time when there was still magic in the world and honor in the hearts of men. The world became ours, and we lost it. Nothing, it appears, is more challenging to the souls of men than victory itself.
